title: H3 Ref Chain plans
description: Two documents. `shot_plan` goes in the shot_plan widget, `ref_plan` in the ref_plan widget. Generated by tools/gen_schema.py from the installed node -- do not edit by hand.

beat.description: What happens THIS hop. Shot 1 is the whole opening; every later shot is only the new beat.

join.description: continuous: The camera and the action carry straight on from the pinned frames in one unbroken take. | match_cut: The shot changes on a matched movement, the new framing picking up the same gesture already underway. | hard_cut: A clean cut opens a new setup, the same place a moment later.

camera.description: hold: The camera holds its position throughout. | pan_follow: The camera pans smoothly to follow the movement, holding it in frame. | push_in: The camera pushes slowly in. | pull_back: The camera draws slowly back, opening the frame. | orbit: The camera arcs slowly around the action. | handheld: The camera carries a light handheld float.

framing.description: keep: The framing stays as it is. | wide: A wide shot with the full room in view. | medium: A medium shot from the waist up. | close: A close shot, head and shoulders filling the frame.

pace.description: slow: Everything moves at an unhurried pace. | steady: The action moves at a steady, even pace. | brisk: The action moves briskly.

tail.description: ongoing: The action is still underway as the clip ends. | settle: The movement eases to a rest and stays there. | hold: The final position holds steady through the last moments.

directives.description: Compiled in the order join, camera, framing, pace, tail. `join` is ignored on shot 1.

prose.description: Appended verbatim, for anything the vocabulary lacks. Phrase it affirmatively.

locked.description: Reuse this hop's cached render even when its inputs changed. Needs cache_hops=on.

tone.description: Opt out of tone_compensate=anchor's pull toward hop 1's exposure. 'free' skips it for this hop; 'rebase' also moves the anchor onto this hop, for a scene that is deliberately darker or brighter from here on. Omit it unless that is the case.

anchor.description: Re-anchor the chain on the start image at this hop instead of relaying the previous one. Bounds the quality decay on a long chain: every hop otherwise inherits its predecessor's most settled frames, so motion and lighting response fade the further in you go. It is a CUT -- the hop opens on the start image's pose, not where the previous hop ended -- so pair it with join 'hard_cut' and write the beat as a fresh start. Needs a start image, never on shot 1, and only on a chain long enough to need one (roughly every 4-6 hops).

refs.description: Which register stills ride this hop, as @tags without the @. Omit the field for the register default (unscheduled stills on chain starts, off continuations). An empty list is explicit none -- how you drop identity stills on a pin-less restart. A filled list is those tags only, in that order.

moment.description: pin_mech=hand_tie only: what is on screen as this hop starts, a pose and a place in one sentence. A spoken line that crosses into this hop goes here, once, and not in the beat. Omit otherwise.

moment_end.description: pin_mech=hand_tie, last shot only: what is on screen as the section ends. Omit otherwise.

shots.description: One shot per hop. The shot count IS the hop count.

file.description: Basename under ComfyUI/input/h3_refs. When source is refmod, the safetensors name under models/refmods. A subfolder is allowed there. Do not include .safetensors.

source.description: image is a still in h3_refs. refmod is a stored VAE latent. Omit for a still.

strength.description: RefMod only. 1 keeps the stored latent. Lower mixes it toward a blur of itself. Omit for 1.

slot.description: Derived from list position. Do not author it; present only for legacy plans.

subject.description: Groups pictures OF THE SAME PERSON. Two different people under one number makes the model render the average of their faces.

retention.description: fully_preserved: face, bone structure, and hairstyle carry over exactly | partially_copy: the garment and its cut carry over, moving naturally with the body | reference: the layout, surfaces, and light carry over as the setting

voice.description: Optional audio basename in h3_refs -- the voice this reference speaks with. It rides beside the picture or clip as its own <Audio N>, a video RefMod included. It is cited on exactly the hops this row rides, which is what voice_file 1-3 cannot do. At most 3 standalone voices.

voice_start.description: Start of the voice's trim window, in seconds, set by the person on the rail. Do not author it: omit the field.

voice_end.description: End of the voice's trim window, in seconds; 0 is the end of the file. Set on the rail. Do not author it: omit the field.

shots.description: 1-based hops this picture rides on. OMITTING IT MEANS HOP 1 ONLY on a continuation chain -- a plate shot elsewhere riding a later hop beats the frame pin.

mp.description: Per-reference pixel budget in MEGApixels, set by the person on the rail. Do not author it: omit the field. It is here so a hand-written plan can carry one, and a written value is discarded on the pinned path. A set value has a 0.3 MP floor and a 16 MP ceiling; 0 means no cap.

refs.description: At most 9 pictures on any one hop. Keep the whole list to 9 and that always holds.

name.description: Plain prose that replaces the @tag from hop 2 on, e.g. 'the cook'. Never an @tag.

locked.description: What must not change. This is what survives on a hop where the photograph is absent.

context.description: Situational state that should persist -- wardrobe, what they are holding.

subjects.description: Keyed by subject number, as a STRING. Every subject here must be claimed by at least one ref, or the plan is rejected.

x-rules: cfg is 1.0 with no negative branch: the prompt is ADDITIVE. Anything named is added; nothing can be removed by mentioning it. Never write a negation.
Never name the thing you want to end. 'stops talking' keeps them talking. Write the state as a pose plus a sound.
H3 always generates audio. Silence must be written AS a sound -- room tone, a refrigerator, a single click.
Ambience must be narrowband. 'faint street noise' renders as hiss; 'the low hum of the refrigerator' renders as a refrigerator.
A state change belongs at the END of the previous shot. Every hop opens holding the frames it was handed.
Shot 1 establishes everything. Later shots carry ONLY the new beat -- never re-describe the face, the clothes or the room.
Write @tags into the action line. Describing a reference in the register does not make the model use it.
Set `tail` to settle or hold on the FINAL shot, or the model is told action is still underway at the last frame and invents something to satisfy it.
